fields.description: {{sbc|Innate - Living Weapon:}} '''Kai'Sa''' can evolve each of her {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} by gaining a set amount of permanent [[Champion statistic|stats]] from [[item]]s and {{tt|stat growth|Includes all stats gained when leveling (including base AD gained), but does not include stats at level 1.}}, granting them additional effects. Evolving an ability causes her to enter a 2-second [[cast time]]. The upgrade is lost if the stat requirement is no longer met.
fields.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Plasma:}} '''Kai'Sa's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' apply {{tip|stacks}} of {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 5 times. Basic attacks each apply 1 stack and ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' applies 2 stacks, increased to 3 if it is {{ai|Void Seeker 2|Kai'Sa|evolved}}. Her and nearby allies' {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effects and {{tip|polymorph|polymorphs}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} will also apply a stack of {{as|Plasma|buzzword}}.
fields.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Caustic Wounds:}} {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} stacks applied by '''Kai'Sa's''' basic attacks or ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' deal {{as|{{pplevel|4 to 24}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} plus {{as|{{pplevel|1 to 6}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} {{as|per Plasma stack before application|buzzword}}, up to a total of {{as|{{pplevel|(4+1*4) to (24+6*4)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12+3*4}}% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} at {{as|4 Plasma stacks before application|buzzword}}. The fifth stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} equal to {{as|15% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''missing''' health|health}}, capped at 400 against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
